name: Yamatokōriyama (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Yamatokōriyama city emblem in white: an outlined lozenge enclosing a stylised character of interlocking strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Yamatokōriyama, a city in Nara Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 17 January 1974.

features.role: Yamatokōriyama city emblem — an outlined lozenge enclosing a stylised character of interlocking strokes
